research.question: Does the fixed confirmation-first BTCUSDT five-minute candle interpretation have positive mean net R on untouched 2025 data?
research.hypothesis: Mean net R after fixed modeled costs and funding is positive.

project_choices.decision: Strict 20/50 close EMA two-period confirmed fractal; fixed 1.5R target, stop at confirmation EMA50, one position; modeled fees 5bp and slippage 2bp each side.
2025-01-01 through 2026-01-01 UTC; reserve the preceding 500 warm-up bars until after freeze.

uncertainties.statement: Seven-day bootstrap shows substantial undercoverage in persistent synthetic daily dependence; inference must be independently justified before freeze.
Study holdout ingestion, platform-bound execution and independent semantic verification are not yet implemented.

inputs: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 5m holdout archives and checksums
Public funding history with associated marks
method.population: 365 UTC days of 2025 Binance BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual 5m candles.
method.eligibility: Complete 5m coverage, 500 preceding warmup bars, all funding settlements, at least 200 trades and 30 exit days; no open trade at end.
method.time_boundary: Development 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-30 00:00 UTC; holdout 2025-01-01 to 2026-01-01 UTC; warm-up reserved after freeze.
method.transformations: Confirmation-first EMA/fractal execution and modeled funding, fees and slippage as documented in explore/ohlcv-protocol.md.
method.acceptance_rule: Proposed only: lower bound of a valid two-sided 95% dependence-aware confidence interval for mean net R exceeds zero; adequacy required.
method.inference_criterion: BLOCKED: seven-day circular block bootstrap does not achieve adequate coverage under persistent synthetic dependence; no final inference rule approved.

non_goals: Actual trading or verified exchange fills

study_owned.description: Decode, evaluate, report, and independently verify study sources and results.
Specify and validate dependence-aware inference before freeze.
